slug: 2025-07-15 Zimbabwe looks forward to digital ID rollout after population registry reform

systems.owner: Ministry of Home Affairs and Cultural Heritage; Registrar-General
systems.tiers: issuance programmed to begin in Harare and Bulawayo before the rest of the country; not started as at 15 July 2025
upgrade begun around 2023, linked to other services

systems.owner: government, with UNICEF and the Swedish Embassy

note: A report on a digital ID issuance announced for July 2025 and not yet started: identity enrolment and mobile campaigns; it says a reform of the civil registry was concluded without saying what the reform did to how births or deaths are recorded.
